text: 近日从中国铁路上海局集团有限公司获悉，2026年铁路中秋国庆假期运输期限自9月23日始，至10月8日止，为期16天。本次假期运输，长三角铁路预计发送旅客5400万人次，客流最高峰日为10月1日，当天预计发送旅客440万人次，有望创下中秋国庆假期运输单日旅客发送量新高。（上证报）
text_en: Recently, it was learned from China Railway Shanghai Group Co., Ltd. that the 2026 railway Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holiday transportation period will run for 16 days from September 23 to October 8. During this holiday transportation period, railways in the Yangtze River Delta are expected to send 54 million passengers, with the peak travel day on October 1, when 4.4 million passengers are expected to be sent, likely setting a new high for single-day passenger volume during Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holiday transportation. (Shanghai Securities News)
